note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json (500 rows, all with score_v3) and S3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl, fetched to runs/theory-tests/m03rival/T3.jsonl. The named grader file studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py is a CLI that calls rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text), so the script calls that function directly. grade_v3 already scores an empty or absent extraction as 0. Main: wrong = v3 == 0 or cap_hit. alt_measured: wrong = v3 == 0 only, with cap_hit not added. Bootstrap is over the Q problems that have a T3 row; n = that count. The other reading of the selection would be n_generated < 2000; it was not computed.

Files: top8 per_problem.json, day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl, and T3.jsonl (S3, runs/theory-tests/m03rival). Wrong = grade_v3 score 0 or cap_hit. Q and C are both limited to problems that have a T3 row. C needs exactly 4 attempt == 0 rows in rows.jsonl with at least 3 of them score_v3 == 1, using the stored score_v3, which is not re-graded. alt_measured: the same contrast, but the cued k uses the final attempt (highest attempt, i.e. after restarts) of each (problem, sample) instead of attempt 0. Bootstrap resamples the pooled Q+C problem list, labelled by group. A resample with an empty group returns 0.0, which is unlikely to happen. n = min(|Q|, |C|).

Files: top8 per_problem.json and S3 r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl, fetched to runs/theory-tests/m03rival/P_math500.jsonl. The file has 1 row per problem. The script keeps the row with the smallest sample value; on a tie it keeps the first row in file order. v3 comes from rln4_lib.grade_v3 on text and gold, with an empty extraction scored 0. Main: wrong = v3 == 0 or cap_hit. alt_measured: wrong = v3 == 0 only. n = number of Q problems that have a P row.

Files: P_math500.jsonl (S3 r3/base-01) and the cued rows.jsonl. Score = grade_v3 score_v3, set to 0 when cap_hit. Self-open filter: the recipe's '\nOkay' is read as newline + 'Okay' inside text[:60]. alt_measured: the filter is the regex (^|\n)\s*Okay in text[:60], which also catches text that starts with 'Okay' or has whitespace before it. A literal backslash-n reading would drop nothing. k comes from attempt == 0 rows, exactly 4 required. E = k == 4, H = k <= 1. Problems without exactly 4 attempt-0 rows are left out. If a group is empty, the script prints not_computable ('report nothing'), not a refutation. Bootstrap is over the pooled E+H problems, and n = min(|E|, |H|).

Files: T3.jsonl (first row per problem), P_math500.jsonl (smallest sample per problem), and the cued rows.jsonl. Wrong = grade_v3 score 0, or cap_hit, or an extraction that is None or blank, applied to both T3 and P. The problem set is problems with exactly 4 attempt-0 cued rows, all with stored score_v3 == 1, that have rows in both T3 and P. a - b = T3-wrong rate given P wrong minus T3-wrong rate given P right. alt_measured: the problem set uses the final attempt per (problem, sample) instead of attempt 0. If a conditioning group is empty, the script prints not_computable. Bootstrap is over the problems in the set, as (P_wrong, T3_wrong) pairs. A resample with an empty group returns 0.0. n = the smaller conditioning group, which may be small (few P-wrong problems on easy items), so the interval may be wide.
